scores.rationale: Six 1966 80% silver 50c (about 64g silver) plus a Coronation crown and $5 coin; realistic value around $100-150, mostly melt.
Mixed worn badges and pins; the MCC and YMCA items are minor, so a few dollars each at best.
Common 1977 Centenary cover with a small sterling medallion; modest melt and collector value.
Mostly base metal coins and commemorative medallions; flower medallions are unproven and likely plated or not silver.
Circulated ten shilling note plus common paper notes and world notes; low value overall.
1988 $10 commemorative in folder and common Japanese invasion notes; each worth only a few to ~$20.
Bulk circulated pennies, some possible pre-1947 silver florins and half crowns, plus stone tools; modest total.
Two complete 2016 ANZAC folders and UK and RAM sets; steady but low per-item values, perhaps $50-80 total.
Bulk mixed base metal world coins with no key dates; sells by weight.
Cased 12 coin proof set from the Pacific; likely mostly silver-plated cupronickel, low market value.
